import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
os.environ["QT_QPA_PLATFORM"] = "offscreen"
from qr_app.presentation.qt_environment import configure_qt_environment
configure_qt_environment()
from PyQt5.QtCore import QTimer
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QMainWindow, QPushButton
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
from qr_app.presentation import png_dialog
from qr_app.service import QRService
from scripts.preview_qr import main

target = ROOT / "tmp/png_pre_publish/window_saved.png"
target.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
assert not target.exists()
checks = {"button_clicked": False, "same_canvas": False, "saved_pixels_match_canvas": False,
          "canvas_draw_after_save": False}
show = QMainWindow.show
save = png_dialog.save_figure
generate = QRService.generate_qr

def checked_save(figure, path, **kwargs):
    canvas = figure.canvas
    canvas.draw()
    before = np.asarray(canvas.buffer_rgba()).copy()
    artifact = save(figure, path, **kwargs)
    checks["same_canvas"] = figure.canvas is canvas
    with Image.open(artifact.path) as image:
        checks["saved_pixels_match_canvas"] = bool(np.array_equal(before, np.asarray(image.convert("RGBA"))))
    canvas.draw()
    checks["canvas_draw_after_save"] = True
    return artifact

def shown(window):
    show(window)
    def click():
        buttons = [b for b in window.findChildren(QPushButton) if b.text() == "Save PNG"]
        assert len(buttons) == 1
        checks["button_clicked"] = True
        buttons[0].click()
    QTimer.singleShot(50, click)

with patch.object(QMainWindow, "show", shown), \
        patch.object(png_dialog.QFileDialog, "getSaveFileName", return_value=(str(target), "PNG image (*.png)")), \
        patch.object(png_dialog.QMessageBox, "information") as info, \
        patch.object(png_dialog.QMessageBox, "warning") as warning, \
        patch.object(png_dialog, "save_figure", side_effect=checked_save) as saved, \
        patch.object(QRService, "generate_qr", autospec=True, side_effect=generate) as generated:
    sys.argv = ["preview_qr.py", "--offscreen", "--text", "known", "--close-after-ms", "1200"]
    code = main()
    checks["single_generation"] = generated.call_count == 1
    checks["single_save"] = saved.call_count == 1
    checks["success_message"] = info.call_count == 1
    checks["no_save_error"] = warning.call_count == 0
    checks["normal_close"] = code == 0
result = {"checks": checks, "all_passed": all(checks.values()), "path": str(target)}
print("PNG_ACTION_RESULT=" + json.dumps(result))
sys.exit(0 if result["all_passed"] else 1)
